page_title: FRO 3-0 SAL | Frosinone v Salernitana 26/04/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' That's the end of the match.

90+3' Francesco Gelli (Frosinone) sends the ball into the penalty area from a free kick a few yards outside the box. The cross is good, but the goalkeeper shows himself in a good light as he leaps high to intercept the ball.
90+2' Francesco Gelli (Frosinone) and Emanuele Valeri combine brilliantly in a series of one-twos.
90+1' What a chance that is! Federico Fazio (Salernitana) displays good awareness near the penalty spot to get on the end of a cross, but he sends his header just over the crossbar.
90' 3 additional min. will be played.
90' The corner is swung in but Salernitana can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

90' Loum Tchaouna (Salernitana) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Salernitana.
89' Toma Basic (Salernitana) takes the free kick which is dealt with by the opposition defence.
88' Loum Tchaouna (Salernitana) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Francesco Fourneau blows his whistle for a foul. Free kick. Frosinone will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
87' The game has come to an end for Luca Mazzitelli. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Francesco Gelli (Frosinone).

85' 3 - 0 The defending players give Nadir Zortea (Frosinone) far too much free space and he knows how to take advantage of it. He produces a howitzer in the direction of the bottom left corner. Benoit Costil was taken unawares by his effort and the score is 3:0.
84' Lassana Coulibaly (Salernitana) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit cross to the back post.
83' Domagoj Bradaric (Salernitana) has the ability to send the ball deep into the penalty area from throw-ins and it can lead to very promising situations for his team.
82' A pass from Loum Tchaouna (Salernitana) is intercepted by Stefano Turati and the move breaks down.
81' Lorenzo Pirola (Salernitana) misses a golden opportunity to score from inside the six-yard box after firing the ball over the crossbar.
80' This corner kick is taken with a short pass by Loum Tchaouna (Salernitana).

79' Chukwubuikem Ikwuemesi (Salernitana) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders. The ball goes out of play. Salernitana are awarded a corner kick.
78' Eusebio Di Francesco has decided to substitute Walid Cheddira and he is replaced by Marvin Cuni (Frosinone).
78' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Ilario Monterisi (Frosinone) will replace Caleb Okoli.
77' Here's the current ball possession statistics for both teams – 46:54.
75' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Iron Gomis (Salernitana) replaces Emanuel Vignato.
74' Iron Gomis (Salernitana) peels away from his marker to receive a lofted pass, but sends his rocket of a shot just wide of the left post from inside the box.
73' Emanuele Valeri (Frosinone) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety. The ball is out of play. Frosinone will take a throw-in.
71' Eusebio Di Francesco is forced to make an unplanned substitution as Pol Lirola (Frosinone) suffers an injury and Kevin Bonifazi comes on.
70' Pol Lirola (Frosinone) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
69' Chukwubuikem Ikwuemesi (Salernitana) feels very aggrieved after the referee stops play for a foul that he commits while in possession of the ball.

68' Caleb Okoli (Frosinone) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Francesco Fourneau with no other option than to blow for a foul.
67' The ball is cleared after Walid Cheddira (Frosinone) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
66' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Junior Sambia departs the field of play to be replaced by Alessandro Zanoli (Salernitana).
65' Junior Sambia (Salernitana) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.
64' Walid Cheddira (Frosinone) has a go from distance but he can't find the target as it goes well wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Salernitana.
63' Luca Mazzitelli (Frosinone) takes the corner which is cleared by the opposition's defence.
62' Emanuele Valeri (Frosinone) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Frosinone.
61' Marco Brescianini (Frosinone) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit chip pass.
61' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Nadir Zortea (Frosinone).
59' An attempted cross from Marco Brescianini (Frosinone) is cleared.
58' Benoit Costil (Salernitana) shows his brilliant passing ability after picking out Loum Tchaouna with a fine lofted pass.
56' A player from Salernitana commits an attacking foul. The referee blows his whistle.
54' Frosinone are showing great team chemistry. They are passing the ball around seamlessly.
52' The Chukwubuikem Ikwuemesi (Salernitana) turns away in celebration as the ball hits the net, but his joy is short-lived as referee Francesco Fourneau rules it out for a foul.
51' Domagoj Bradaric (Salernitana) is heading toward the corner flag to take the set piece.
51' Domagoj Bradaric (Salernitana) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat. Salernitana have been awarded a corner kick.
50' Yellow card. Luca Mazzitelli (Frosinone) goes into the book for a bad tackle on his opponent.
49' Federico Fazio (Salernitana) attempts to send a pass but the effort is blocked.
47' Matias Soule (Frosinone) swings in a dangerous cross from the resulting corner kick, but none of his teammates manage to outjump the defence.
46' Emanuele Valeri (Frosinone) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence. Frosinone win a corner.
46' Half-time substitution. Niccolo Pierozzi (Salernitana) is replaced by Triantafyllos Pasalidis.
46' Eusebio Di Francesco makes a switch. Michele Cerofolini is coming on in place of Stefano Turati (Frosinone) at the start of the second period.
46' Referee Francesco Fourneau blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+3' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+2' Walid Cheddira (Frosinone) starts his run too early and the referee blows for offside.
45+2' Frosinone work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.

45+2' A promising cross into the box is nearly received by the lurking Marco Brescianini (Frosinone), but one of the defending players cuts it out to avert the threat. The linesman makes the right call and Frosinone will have a corner.
45' The fourth official shows 2 min. of added time.
45' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Nadir Zortea (Frosinone), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
45' The actual number of corner kicks in this match – 4:0.

44' Toma Basic (Salernitana) attempts to surprise the keeper with a shot from distance, but it lacks accuracy and goes high over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Frosinone will have a goal kick.

43' Lassana Coulibaly (Salernitana) collects a rebound a long way out and doesn't hesitate to release a goal-bound hammer of a shot. His attempt is precise and towards the middle of the target. It would have ended in the back of the net if it wasn't for Stefano Turati and his nice save.
43' Junior Sambia (Salernitana) takes the free-kick from mid-range but it's blocked by the defensive wall.
42' Junior Sambia (Salernitana) is going to send the ball in from the free kick.
42' Domagoj Bradaric (Salernitana) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
42' Domagoj Bradaric (Salernitana) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
41' Nadir Zortea (Frosinone) receives a yellow card from the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
40' Toma Basic (Salernitana) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.
39' What a wasted chance that was! A precise cross into the box finds Marco Brescianini (Frosinone), whose header goes wide of the goal.
39' A goal, which was scored by Emanuel Vignato (Salernitana), was disallowed due to offside.
36' Niccolo Pierozzi (Salernitana) is cautioned by the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
35' Chukwubuikem Ikwuemesi (Salernitana) changes the direction of the ball using his hand, but he is angry when the referee gives a foul against him. Frosinone earn a free kick.
33' Stefano Turati displays his ability to read the game and clears the danger after Emanuel Vignato (Salernitana) threatened to latch onto a through ball from just outside the box.

31' Emanuel Vignato (Salernitana) shows off his amazing technique to get to the edge of the box by himself. He pulls the trigger but sends the ball miles wide of the right post. Nice run, but poor finish!
31' Caleb Okoli (Frosinone) peeled away from his marker and got on the end of the resulting corner, but he sends his header straight at the goalkeeper.
31' Luca Mazzitelli (Frosinone) takes the corner.
30' That's unlucky! Walid Cheddira (Frosinone) beautifully controls a pass and from the edge of the box drills a shot in on goal, but it's inadvertently blocked by a defender and cleared.
28' A cross is whipped in towards Lassana Coulibaly (Salernitana) on the edge of the six-yard box. He wins the ball but sends his header just wide of the right post.
27' Federico Fazio (Salernitana) and Niccolo Pierozzi matched up again to find some space for an unmarked teammate.
25' 2 - 0 Goal! Emanuele Valeri provides Marco Brescianini (Frosinone) with a nice pass inside the box. It allows him to finish with a precise effort into the bottom left corner. 2:0.
25' Emanuel Vignato (Salernitana) delivers a low pass into the box which is intercepted.
24' Luca Mazzitelli (Frosinone) makes a rough challenge and Francesco Fourneau blows his whistle for a foul.
23' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Frosinone.
23' Nadir Zortea (Frosinone) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked. Frosinone force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
21' Loum Tchaouna (Salernitana) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Stefano Turati intercepts the ball.
19' Walid Cheddira (Frosinone) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.
17' Simone Romagnoli (Frosinone) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent. Salernitana are awarded the free kick.
16' Frosinone have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
14' Lassana Coulibaly (Salernitana) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Francesco Fourneau has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
12' Loum Tchaouna (Salernitana) strikes a bullet of a shot towards goal from distance and forces the goalkeeper to make a good save.
12' The Salernitana players are exchanging short passes in an attempt to create a shooting opportunity.
10' 1 - 0 Matias Soule (Frosinone) coolly converts the penalty. His precise shot goes inside the left post, leaving the goalkeeper helpless.
10' Matias Soule (Frosinone) is going to take the penalty!
9' Junior Sambia (Salernitana) shouldn't be surprised it's a yellow from the ref, who cooled the situation down well.
9' Junior Sambia (Salernitana) pulls the shirt of his opponent and the referee stops play for a foul. That's a penalty to Frosinone! They have a good chance to score now.
7' Federico Fazio (Salernitana) sends a long crossfield pass searching out one of his teammates, but his effort comes to nothing and they lose possession.
5' Frosinone take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

5' Matias Soule (Frosinone) skips past a few defenders in the penalty area and strikes a low shot towards the left side of the goal, but the goalkeeper denies his effort with a superb save. The referee points to the corner flag and Frosinone will take a corner.
4' Emanuel Vignato (Salernitana) gets in a good position inside the box and is only inches away from getting on the end of a through ball from the edge of the area.
2' Benoit Costil displays his ability to read the game and clears the danger after Walid Cheddira (Frosinone) threatened to latch onto a through ball from just outside the box.
1' The match has just started.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Salernitana will have the kick-off.
The referee of today's match will be Francesco Fourneau.
